National Rail cares about your privacy

National Rail uses cookies to provide, analyse and improve our services, and depending on how you choose may also include personalising content or advertising. Your data will not be used for tracking purposes if you have asked us not to track.
We and our 148 partners store and access personal data, like browsing data or unique identifiers, on your device. Selecting Accept All enables tracking technologies to support the purposes shown under we and our partners process data to provide. Selecting Reject All or withdrawing your consent will disable them. If trackers are disabled, some content and ads you see may not be as relevant to you. You can resurface this menu to change your choices or withdraw consent at any time by clicking the Manage Preferences link on the bottom of the webpage. Your choices will have effect within our Website. For more details, refer to our Privacy Policy.

Departures Arrivals Departing from Going to (optional) Swap from and to stations Show live trains Top Stories All the latest from National Rail. Watch Train-ing It with Joe Wilkinson National Rail teamed up with Channel 4 for the show, which sees the comedian accompany guests like Nick Mohammed, Michael Sheen and Anna Williamson on a train journey that means something to them. Find all 5 episodes on Channel 4’s YouTube channel now The Big Rail Fare Freeze Rail fares have been frozen until March 2027, benefitting more than a billion passenger journeys across England. See how much your ticket will cost… Pride by Train Every summer there are LGBTQIA+ Pride marches and celebrations throughout Great Britain. See the biggest events, and how to get there by train Advertisement More Information Learn more about National Rail’s goals and services. 6 of the Best British Dupe Destinations by Train Why not swap a European holiday hotspot for one of these top British locations, whether you want beaches, countryside, culture or more! Accessibility We want everyone to be able to access our services – here’s what we do to support customers Get 1/3 off with a Railcard From children to seniors, there are lots of different Railcards – see which one is right for you Watch our planned disruption videos Sometimes planned engineering works can impact your journey, and you may need to travel by a different route or use rail replacement services. htmlAfterStep.bodyTextExcerpt: SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan start marker Skip to main content Advertisement Live Departures Status and Disruptions Plan a Journey My Travel Tickets, Railcards and Offers Stations Travel Information Discover by Train Help and Assistance Plan Your Journey Departing from Going to Swap from and to stations Live Departures Find real-time departure and arrival information for any National Rail station in Great Britain. Departures Arrivals Departing from Going to (optional) Swap from and to stations Show live trains Top Stories All the latest from National Rail. Watch Train-ing It with Joe Wilkinson National Rail teamed up with Channel 4 for the show, which sees the comedian accompany guests like Nick Mohammed, Michael Sheen and Anna Williamson on a train journey that means something to them. Find all 5 episodes on Channel 4’s YouTube channel now The Big Rail Fare Freeze Rail fares have been frozen until March 2027, benefitting more than a billion passenger journeys across England. See how much your ticket will cost… Pride by Train Every summer there are LGBTQIA+ Pride marches and celebrations throughout Great Britain. See the biggest events, and how to get there by train Advertisement More Information Learn more about National Rail’s goals and services. 6 of the Best British Dupe Destinations by Train Why not swap a European holiday hotspot for one of these top British locations, whether you want beaches, countryside, culture or more! Accessibility We want everyone to be able to access our services – here’s what we do to support customers Get 1/3 off with a Railcard From children to seniors, there are lots of different Railcards – see which one is right for you Watch our planned disruption videos Sometimes planned engineering works can impact your journey, and you may need to travel by a different route or use rail replacement services. htmlAfterStep.bodyTextExcerpt: SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan start marker Skip to main content Advertisement Live Departures Status and Disruptions Plan a Journey My Travel Tickets, Railcards and Offers Stations Travel Information Discover by Train Help and Assistance Plan Your Journey Departing from Going to Swap from and to stations Live Departures Find real-time departure and arrival information for any National Rail station in Great Britain. Departures Arrivals Departing from Going to (optional) Swap from and to stations Show live trains Top Stories All the latest from National Rail. Watch Train-ing It with Joe Wilkinson National Rail teamed up with Channel 4 for the show, which sees the comedian accompany guests like Nick Mohammed, Michael Sheen and Anna Williamson on a train journey that means something to them. Find all 5 episodes on Channel 4’s YouTube channel now The Big Rail Fare Freeze Rail fares have been frozen until March 2027, benefitting more than a billion passenger journeys across England. See how much your ticket will cost… Pride by Train Every summer there are LGBTQIA+ Pride marches and celebrations throughout Great Britain. See the biggest events, and how to get there by train Advertisement More Information Learn more about National Rail’s goals and services. 6 of the Best British Dupe Destinations by Train Why not swap a European holiday hotspot for one of these top British locations, whether you want beaches, countryside, culture or more! Accessibility We want everyone to be able to access our services – here’s what we do to support customers Get 1/3 off with a Railcard From children to seniors, there are lots of different Railcards – see which one is right for you Watch our planned disruption videos Sometimes planned engineering works can impact your journey, and you may need to travel by a different route or use rail replacement services. Where this happens, we provide short, accessible videos to help you plan your journey Save big with National Rail Ride and Shop Download the Chrome extension to your desktop browser and you can save money on your online shopping at over 100,000 stores Use our Carbon Calculator to check your carbon footprint Compare your carbon emissions for a National Rail train journey with car or plane travel on more than 40,000 rail journeys across Britain with the Green Travel Data Carbon Calculator Tickets, Railcards and Offers Buying a Ticket Ticket Types Railcards Saving Money Stations and Train Companies Find a Station Find a Train Company Travel Information Alerts and Notifications Timetables Future Engineering Works Safe Train Travel Sustainability Destinations Trains from London Paddington to Heathrow Airport Trains from London to Liverpool Trains from London to Birmingham Trains from Edinburgh to Kings Cross Trains from Gatwick Airport to London Help and Assistance Compensation and Refunds Contact Us Complaints Passenger Assist Media Text 61016 On the Train Accessible Train Travel and Facilities Train Travel with Bicycles Train Travel with Pets Train Travel with Children Food and Drink © 2026 About This Site Accessible Information Careers Cookies Privacy Notice Terms and Conditions National Rail Enquiries - Official source for UK train times and timetables SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan end marker

Departures Arrivals Departing from Going to (optional) Swap from and to stations Show live trains Top Stories All the latest from National Rail. Watch Train-ing It with Joe Wilkinson National Rail teamed up with Channel 4 for the show, which sees the comedian accompany guests like Nick Mohammed, Michael Sheen and Anna Williamson on a train journey that means something to them. Find all 5 episodes on Channel 4’s YouTube channel now The Big Rail Fare Freeze Rail fares have been frozen until March 2027, benefitting more than a billion passenger journeys across England. See how much your ticket will cost… Pride by Train Every summer there are LGBTQIA+ Pride marches and celebrations throughout Great Britain. See the biggest events, and how to get there by train Advertisement More Information Learn more about National Rail’s goals and services. 6 of the Best British Dupe Destinations by Train Why not swap a European holiday hotspot for one of these top British locations, whether you want beaches, countryside, culture or more! Accessibility We want everyone to be able to access our services – here’s what we do to support customers Get 1/3 off with a Railcard From children to seniors, there are lots of different Railcards – see which one is right for you Watch our planned disruption videos Sometimes planned engineering works can impact your journey, and you may need to travel by a different route or use rail replacement services. htmlAfterStep.bodyTextExcerpt: SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan start marker Skip to main content Advertisement Live Departures Status and Disruptions Plan a Journey My Travel Tickets, Railcards and Offers Stations Travel Information Discover by Train Help and Assistance Plan Your Journey Departing from Going to Swap from and to stations Live Departures Find real-time departure and arrival information for any National Rail station in Great Britain. Departures Arrivals Departing from Going to (optional) Swap from and to stations Show live trains Top Stories All the latest from National Rail. Watch Train-ing It with Joe Wilkinson National Rail teamed up with Channel 4 for the show, which sees the comedian accompany guests like Nick Mohammed, Michael Sheen and Anna Williamson on a train journey that means something to them. Find all 5 episodes on Channel 4’s YouTube channel now The Big Rail Fare Freeze Rail fares have been frozen until March 2027, benefitting more than a billion passenger journeys across England. See how much your ticket will cost… Pride by Train Every summer there are LGBTQIA+ Pride marches and celebrations throughout Great Britain. See the biggest events, and how to get there by train Advertisement More Information Learn more about National Rail’s goals and services. 6 of the Best British Dupe Destinations by Train Why not swap a European holiday hotspot for one of these top British locations, whether you want beaches, countryside, culture or more! Accessibility We want everyone to be able to access our services – here’s what we do to support customers Get 1/3 off with a Railcard From children to seniors, there are lots of different Railcards – see which one is right for you Watch our planned disruption videos Sometimes planned engineering works can impact your journey, and you may need to travel by a different route or use rail replacement services. Where this happens, we provide short, accessible videos to help you plan your journey Save big with National Rail Ride and Shop Download the Chrome extension to your desktop browser and you can save money on your online shopping at over 100,000 stores Use our Carbon Calculator to check your carbon footprint Compare your carbon emissions for a National Rail train journey with car or plane travel on more than 40,000 rail journeys across Britain with the Green Travel Data Carbon Calculator Tickets, Railcards and Offers Buying a Ticket Ticket Types Railcards Saving Money Stations and Train Companies Find a Station Find a Train Company Travel Information Alerts and Notifications Timetables Future Engineering Works Safe Train Travel Sustainability Destinations Trains from London Paddington to Heathrow Airport Trains from London to Liverpool Trains from London to Birmingham Trains from Edinburgh to Kings Cross Trains from Gatwick Airport to London Help and Assistance Compensation and Refunds Contact Us Complaints Passenger Assist Media Text 61016 On the Train Accessible Train Travel and Facilities Train Travel with Bicycles Train Travel with Pets Train Travel with Children Food and Drink © 2026 About This Site Accessible Information Careers Cookies Privacy Notice Terms and Conditions National Rail Enquiries - Official source for UK train times and timetables SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan end marker

Find all 5 episodes on Channel 4’s YouTube channel now The Big Rail Fare Freeze Rail fares have been frozen until March 2027, benefitting more than a billion passenger journeys across England. htmlAfterStep.bodyTextExcerpt: SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan start marker Skip to main content Advertisement Live Departures Status and Disruptions Plan a Journey My Travel Tickets, Railcards and Offers Stations Travel Information Discover by Train Help and Assistance Plan Your Journey Departing from Going to Swap from and to stations Live Departures Find real-time departure and arrival information for any National Rail station in Great Britain. Departures Arrivals Departing from Going to (optional) Swap from and to stations Show live trains Top Stories All the latest from National Rail. Watch Train-ing It with Joe Wilkinson National Rail teamed up with Channel 4 for the show, which sees the comedian accompany guests like Nick Mohammed, Michael Sheen and Anna Williamson on a train journey that means something to them. Find all 5 episodes on Channel 4’s YouTube channel now The Big Rail Fare Freeze Rail fares have been frozen until March 2027, benefitting more than a billion passenger journeys across England. See how much your ticket will cost… Pride by Train Every summer there are LGBTQIA+ Pride marches and celebrations throughout Great Britain. See the biggest events, and how to get there by train Advertisement More Information Learn more about National Rail’s goals and services. 6 of the Best British Dupe Destinations by Train Why not swap a European holiday hotspot for one of these top British locations, whether you want beaches, countryside, culture or more! Accessibility We want everyone to be able to access our services – here’s what we do to support customers Get 1/3 off with a Railcard From children to seniors, there are lots of different Railcards – see which one is right for you Watch our planned disruption videos Sometimes planned engineering works can impact your journey, and you may need to travel by a different route or use rail replacement services. Where this happens, we provide short, accessible videos to help you plan your journey Save big with National Rail Ride and Shop Download the Chrome extension to your desktop browser and you can save money on your online shopping at over 100,000 stores Use our Carbon Calculator to check your carbon footprint Compare your carbon emissions for a National Rail train journey with car or plane travel on more than 40,000 rail journeys across Britain with the Green Travel Data Carbon Calculator Tickets, Railcards and Offers Buying a Ticket Ticket Types Railcards Saving Money Stations and Train Companies Find a Station Find a Train Company Travel Information Alerts and Notifications Timetables Future Engineering Works Safe Train Travel Sustainability Destinations Trains from London Paddington to Heathrow Airport Trains from London to Liverpool Trains from London to Birmingham Trains from Edinburgh to Kings Cross Trains from Gatwick Airport to London Help and Assistance Compensation and Refunds Contact Us Complaints Passenger Assist Media Text 61016 On the Train Accessible Train Travel and Facilities Train Travel with Bicycles Train Travel with Pets Train Travel with Children Food and Drink © 2026 About This Site Accessible Information Careers Cookies Privacy Notice Terms and Conditions National Rail Enquiries - Official source for UK train times and timetables SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan end marker

htmlAfterStep.bodyTextExcerpt: SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan start marker Skip to main content Advertisement Live Departures Status and Disruptions Plan a Journey My Travel Tickets, Railcards and Offers Stations Travel Information Discover by Train Help and Assistance Plan Your Journey Departing from Going to Swap from and to stations Live Departures Find real-time departure and arrival information for any National Rail station in Great Britain. Departures Arrivals Departing from Set home station Set work station Favourites Nearby Start typing a station name/code, city or town... Type to filter stations, or navigate to recent, favourite and nearby stations. Going to (optional) Swap from and to stations Show live trains Top Stories All the latest from National Rail. Watch Train-ing It with Joe Wilkinson National Rail teamed up with Channel 4 for the show, which sees the comedian accompany guests like Nick Mohammed, Michael Sheen and Anna Williamson on a train journey that means something to them. Find all 5 episodes on Channel 4’s YouTube channel now The Big Rail Fare Freeze Rail fares have been frozen until March 2027, benefitting more than a billion passenger journeys across England. See how much your ticket will cost… Pride by Train Every summer there are LGBTQIA+ Pride marches and celebrations throughout Great Britain. See the biggest events, and how to get there by train Advertisement More Information Learn more about National Rail’s goals and services. 6 of the Best British Dupe Destinations by Train Why not swap a European holiday hotspot for one of these top British locations, whether you want beaches, countryside, culture or more! Accessibility We want everyone to be able to access our services – here’s what we do to support customers Get 1/3 off with a Railcard From children to seniors, there are lots of different Railcards – see which one is right for you Watch our planned disruption videos Sometimes planned engineering works can impact your journey, and you may need to travel by a different route or use rail replacement services. Going to (optional) Type to filter stations, or navigate to recent, favourite and nearby stations. Swap from and to stations Show live trains Top Stories All the latest from National Rail. Watch Train-ing It with Joe Wilkinson National Rail teamed up with Channel 4 for the show, which sees the comedian accompany guests like Nick Mohammed, Michael Sheen and Anna Williamson on a train journey that means something to them. Find all 5 episodes on Channel 4’s YouTube channel now The Big Rail Fare Freeze Rail fares have been frozen until March 2027, benefitting more than a billion passenger journeys across England. See how much your ticket will cost… Pride by Train Every summer there are LGBTQIA+ Pride marches and celebrations throughout Great Britain. See the biggest events, and how to get there by train Advertisement More Information Learn more about National Rail’s goals and services. 6 of the Best British Dupe Destinations by Train Why not swap a European holiday hotspot for one of these top British locations, whether you want beaches, countryside, culture or more! Accessibility We want everyone to be able to access our services – here’s what we do to support customers Get 1/3 off with a Railcard From children to seniors, there are lots of different Railcards – see which one is right for you Watch our planned disruption videos Sometimes planned engineering works can impact your journey, and you may need to travel by a different route or use rail replacement services. Going to (optional) Type to filter stations, or navigate to recent, favourite and nearby stations. Swap from and to stations Show live trains Top Stories All the latest from National Rail. Watch Train-ing It with Joe Wilkinson National Rail teamed up with Channel 4 for the show, which sees the comedian accompany guests like Nick Mohammed, Michael Sheen and Anna Williamson on a train journey that means something to them. Find all 5 episodes on Channel 4’s YouTube channel now The Big Rail Fare Freeze Rail fares have been frozen until March 2027, benefitting more than a billion passenger journeys across England. See how much your ticket will cost… Pride by Train Every summer there are LGBTQIA+ Pride marches and celebrations throughout Great Britain. Departures Arrivals Departing from Please select a station Type to filter stations, or navigate to recent, favourite and nearby stations. Going to (optional) Type to filter stations, or navigate to recent, favourite and nearby stations. Swap from and to stations Show live trains Top Stories All the latest from National Rail. Watch Train-ing It with Joe Wilkinson National Rail teamed up with Channel 4 for the show, which sees the comedian accompany guests like Nick Mohammed, Michael Sheen and Anna Williamson on a train journey that means something to them. Find all 5 episodes on Channel 4’s YouTube channel now The Big Rail Fare Freeze Rail fares have been frozen until March 2027, benefitting more than a billion passenger journeys across England. See how much your ticket will cost… Pride by Train Every summer there are LGBTQIA+ Pride marches and celebrations throughout Great Britain. See the biggest events, and how to get there by train Advertisement More Information Learn more about National Rail’s goals and services. 6 of the Best British Dupe Destinations by Train Why not swap a European holiday hotspot for one of these top British locations, whether you want beaches, countryside, culture or more! Accessibility We want everyone to be able to access our services – here’s what we do to support customers Get 1/3 off with a Railcard From children to seniors, there are lots of different Railcards – see which one is right for you Watch our planned disruption videos Sometimes planned engineering works can impact your journey, and you may need to travel by a different route or use rail replacement services. Departures Arrivals Departing from Please select a station Type to filter stations, or navigate to recent, favourite and nearby stations. Going to (optional) Type to filter stations, or navigate to recent, favourite and nearby stations. Swap from and to stations Show live trains Top Stories All the latest from National Rail. Watch Train-ing It with Joe Wilkinson National Rail teamed up with Channel 4 for the show, which sees the comedian accompany guests like Nick Mohammed, Michael Sheen and Anna Williamson on a train journey that means something to them. Find all 5 episodes on Channel 4’s YouTube channel now The Big Rail Fare Freeze Rail fares have been frozen until March 2027, benefitting more than a billion passenger journeys across England. See how much your ticket will cost… Pride by Train Every summer there are LGBTQIA+ Pride marches and celebrations throughout Great Britain. See the biggest events, and how to get there by train Advertisement More Information Learn more about National Rail’s goals and services. 6 of the Best British Dupe Destinations by Train Why not swap a European holiday hotspot for one of these top British locations, whether you want beaches, countryside, culture or more! Accessibility We want everyone to be able to access our services – here’s what we do to support customers Get 1/3 off with a Railcard From children to seniors, there are lots of different Railcards – see which one is right for you Watch our planned disruption videos Sometimes planned engineering works can impact your journey, and you may need to travel by a different route or use rail replacement services. Going to (optional) Type to filter stations, or navigate to recent, favourite and nearby stations. Swap from and to stations Show live trains Top Stories All the latest from National Rail. Watch Train-ing It with Joe Wilkinson National Rail teamed up with Channel 4 for the show, which sees the comedian accompany guests like Nick Mohammed, Michael Sheen and Anna Williamson on a train journey that means something to them. Find all 5 episodes on Channel 4’s YouTube channel now The Big Rail Fare Freeze Rail fares have been frozen until March 2027, benefitting more than a billion passenger journeys across England. See how much your ticket will cost… Pride by Train Every summer there are LGBTQIA+ Pride marches and celebrations throughout Great Britain. See the biggest events, and how to get there by train Advertisement More Information Learn more about National Rail’s goals and services. 6 of the Best British Dupe Destinations by Train Why not swap a European holiday hotspot for one of these top British locations, whether you want beaches, countryside, culture or more! Accessibility We want everyone to be able to access our services – here’s what we do to support customers Get 1/3 off with a Railcard From children to seniors, there are lots of different Railcards – see which one is right for you Watch our planned disruption videos Sometimes planned engineering works can impact your journey, and you may need to travel by a different route or use rail replacement services. Going to (optional) Type to filter stations, or navigate to recent, favourite and nearby stations. Swap from and to stations Show live trains Top Stories All the latest from National Rail. Watch Train-ing It with Joe Wilkinson National Rail teamed up with Channel 4 for the show, which sees the comedian accompany guests like Nick Mohammed, Michael Sheen and Anna Williamson on a train journey that means something to them. Find all 5 episodes on Channel 4’s YouTube channel now The Big Rail Fare Freeze Rail fares have been frozen until March 2027, benefitting more than a billion passenger journeys across England. See how much your ticket will cost… Pride by Train Every summer there are LGBTQIA+ Pride marches and celebrations throughout Great Britain. See the biggest events, and how to get there by train Advertisement More Information Learn more about National Rail’s goals and services. 6 of the Best British Dupe Destinations by Train Why not swap a European holiday hotspot for one of these top British locations, whether you want beaches, countryside, culture or more! htmlAfterStep.bodyTextExcerpt: SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan start marker Skip to main content Advertisement Live Departures Status and Disruptions Plan a Journey My Travel Tickets, Railcards and Offers Stations Travel Information Discover by Train Help and Assistance Plan Your Journey Departing from Going to Swap from and to stations Live Departures Find real-time departure and arrival information for any National Rail station in Great Britain. Departures Arrivals Departing from Please select a station Type to filter stations, or navigate to recent, favourite and nearby stations. Going to (optional) Type to filter stations, or navigate to recent, favourite and nearby stations. Swap from and to stations Show live trains Top Stories All the latest from National Rail. Watch Train-ing It with Joe Wilkinson National Rail teamed up with Channel 4 for the show, which sees the comedian accompany guests like Nick Mohammed, Michael Sheen and Anna Williamson on a train journey that means something to them. Find all 5 episodes on Channel 4’s YouTube channel now The Big Rail Fare Freeze Rail fares have been frozen until March 2027, benefitting more than a billion passenger journeys across England. See how much your ticket will cost… Pride by Train Every summer there are LGBTQIA+ Pride marches and celebrations throughout Great Britain. See the biggest events, and how to get there by train Advertisement More Information Learn more about National Rail’s goals and services. 6 of the Best British Dupe Destinations by Train Why not swap a European holiday hotspot for one of these top British locations, whether you want beaches, countryside, culture or more! Accessibility We want everyone to be able to access our services – here’s what we do to support customers Get 1/3 off with a Railcard From children to seniors, there are lots of different Railcards – see which one is right for you Watch our planned disruption videos Sometimes planned engineering works can impact your journey, and you may need to travel by a different route or use rail replacement services. Where this happens, we provide short, accessible videos to help you plan your journey Save big with National Rail Ride and Shop Download the Chrome extension to your desktop browser and you can save money on your online shopping at over 100,000 stores Use our Carbon Calculator to check your carbon footprint Compare your carbon emissions for a National Rail train journey with car or plane travel on more than 40,000 rail journeys across Britain with the Green Travel Data Carbon Calculator Tickets, Railcards and Offers Buying a Ticket Ticket Types Railcards Saving Money Stations and Train Companies Find a Station Find a Train Company Travel Information Alerts and Notifications Timetables Future Engineering Works Safe Train Travel Sustainability Destinations Trains from London Paddington to Heathrow Airport Trains from London to Liverpool Trains from London to Birmingham Trains from Edinburgh to Kings Cross Trains from Gatwick Airport to London Help and Assistance Compensation and Refunds Contact Us Complaints Passenger Assist Media Text 61016 On the Train Accessible Train Travel and Facilities Train Travel with Bicycles Train Travel with Pets Train Travel with Children Food and Drink © 2026 About This Site Accessible Information Careers Cookies Privacy Notice Terms and Conditions National Rail Enquiries - Official source for UK train times and timetables SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan end marker
